title: Two-digit clock number
prompt: Clocks show 5 minutes as "05". Return the number as text with at least two digits.
starter:
func solve(n: int) -> String:
	return str(n)
hint: Turn it into text, then look for a method that pads with zeros.
solution:
func solve(n: int) -> String:
	return str(n).pad_zeros(2)
